description: Linux kernel GPIO driver for NCT5104D Super-I/O chip, including register access functions, GPIO bank management, and platform driver initialization.

methods.name: superio_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_inw
methods.description: Reads a word (2 bytes) from the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_enter
methods.description: Enters Super-I/O configuration mode by requesting I/O region and sending unlock key.

methods.name: superio_select
methods.description: Selects a logical device within Super-I/O.

methods.name: superio_exit
methods.description: Exits Super-I/O configuration mode and releases I/O region.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_get
methods.description: Reads the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_direction_out
methods.description: Configures specified GPIO as output and sets its value.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a GPIO pin (version-dependent on kernel version).

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_probe
methods.description: Probe function for platform driver, registers GPIO chips.

methods.name: nct5104d_find
methods.description: Detects the NCT5104D chip at given I/O address and initializes it.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_device_add
methods.description: Creates and registers platform device for GPIO driver.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO driver, finds device, registers driver.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_exit
methods.description: Cleanup function unregistering platform device and driver.
